description.value: Songhees Tours is the only Indigenous-owned and operated tour provider in Victoria's Inner Harbour, offering guided canoe and walking experiences led by Lək̓ʷəŋən cultural hosts from the Songhees Nation. Paddlers step into replica traditional canoes to explore ancestral waterways while learning water protocols, songs, and oral histories; walkers follow the 7 Signs of Lək̓ʷəŋən through downtown Victoria. Tours depart from Ship Point on Wharf Street, placing them right along a popular cycling corridor on the Inner Harbour waterfront.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (20 spaces) at 8m; rack at 41m; rack (12 spaces) at 48m; stands (8 spaces) at 70m. Total: 40 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms Songhees Tours is an active Indigenous-owned canoe and walking tour operator based at 812 Wharf St, Victoria's Inner Harbour. The site provides address, phone, and email but contains no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cyclist-specific amenities. Tours meet at outdoor public locations (Ship Point / Lower Causeway), so amenity evidence is entirely absent from the website.
concerns: OSM record has no osm_id, no address, no phone — all contact details sourced solely from the website. OSM record should be updated with address and phone once confirmed.

Tour meeting points (Ship Point / Lower Causeway) are outdoor public spaces, not a fixed indoor visitor centre; the 812 Wharf St address appears to be an administrative/visitor centre address rather than a tour departure point.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable Indigenous cultural tour business operating in Victoria's Inner Harbour — a highly relevant attraction for cycling tourists exploring the waterfront.
enrichment_extras.notes: Tours depart from Ship Point on Wharf Street (at the Canada sign), which is along the popular Inner Harbour cycling path — a natural stop for touring cyclists. Walking tours run year-round; canoe tours are seasonal (approximately May–October).

wow_evidence: Rubric anchor: delight 3. Only Indigenous-owned tour operator in the Inner Harbour — Lək̓ʷəŋən canoe and walking tours.
